ownPositionChanged: Whole-application comprehension comes before a mascot-versus-wordmark experiment.
Neighboring emotion readings warrant inquiry, not automatic refinement.
finalVerdict: Preserve the tiny character and meaningful visual prominence. Professional interpretation depends on the surrounding authorship and real work; childlike styling alone establishes neither competence nor incompetence. Application-specific fixes can proceed without a formal study. Memorability and attachment remain hypotheses, despite multidisciplinary agreement.
openQuestions: What do unfamiliar readers remember about Nag and one actual project after a day?
Which character beat feels personally true to Nag and remains welcome on repeat viewing?
